RULESET 1.2 · A LINE OVER: ALIGNED · A LINE UNDER: UNALIGNED
Every pairing not written here is a tie. The same vector is a tie, unless one side alone is aligned; then that side takes the ring. An Intel that declares nothing leaves the side unaligned. An Agent that does not commit forfeits the ring; when neither Agent commits, the ring is a tie. A saga ends when either side reaches three forfeited rings; the side with fewer forfeits takes it and equal forfeits is a tie. Where both sides land on one stud, one lime piece stands for the pair.
